title: Bristol
selectSource: Select a card first (a tableau top or fan top)

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card can move to a foundation
frontendHint.moveToTableau: A card can move between tableau columns

tutorial.foundation: The four foundations. Build up from Ace to King regardless of suit. Complete all four to win.
tutorial.tableau: The eight tableau columns. Move the top card onto another column (any suit, descending). Once a column empties it can no longer be used.
tutorial.fan: The three fans (reserve piles). They are dealt from the stock; the top card of each fan can move to a tableau column or foundation.
tutorial.stock: Click the stock to deal one card to each of the three fans.
tutorial.actionButtons: Action buttons: hint, auto-complete, undo, and more.
